DLC2307:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...NO MUSIC, NO LIFE... A song is more than mere vibrations in the air...」

DLC2307:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Throughout the ages and across the world, the power of song has worked all kinds of miracles...」

DLC2307:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place before the fall of $$トウキョウ$$ in $$新日本$$.」

DLC2307:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As the Empire's pressure grew by the day, $$ゼロ$$ was concerned about somewhere beyond the battlefield... the lives of ordinary citizens.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:3.en: ～$$新日本$$: $$トウキョウ$$ Command Headquarters～

DLC2307:3:t_2:5.en:
$$扇$$
「About thirty percent of $$トウキョウ$$'s population wishes to evacuate.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:6.en:
$$千葉$$
「Preparations to receive them in Japan are complete. We expect their transport to be finished by the end of this week.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:8.en:
$$藤堂$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$ will target the capital, $$トウキョウ$$, first. When it does, this place will become a battlefield again.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「To think I would now be defending the city I once tried to conquer.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have no such sentimental feelings. Having been entrusted with $$新日本$$'s defense, I will simply pursue victory.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:12.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We're counting on you, $$ゼロ$$. Given the situation, the $$連邦軍$$ stationed in $$新日本$$ has very little strength.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:13.en:
$$藤堂$$
「We have no choice but to stake everything on your strategic skill.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've already requested assistance from $$プリベンター$$ and various others. Our key forces should be in place in a few weeks.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:16.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll hold out with the forces we have.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:17.en:
$$玉城$$
「It'll be fine! The citizen volunteers will make up for whatever the $$連邦軍$$ lacks!」

DLC2307:3:t_2:18.en:
$$玉城$$
「$$新日本$$ is a nation of resistance fighters! Everyone's fired up, saying they'll never let invaders take it again!」

DLC2307:3:t_2:19.en:
$$扇$$
「That's right. Former members of the $$黒の騎士団$$ have joined the volunteer army too.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:20.en:
$$玉城$$
「$$カレン$$ even cut her studies abroad short to come back.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:22.en:
$$扇$$
「$$スザク$$... I know what you want to say.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:23.en:
$$扇$$
「Ideally, we wouldn't want to be in a situation where civilians have to take up guns.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:24.en:
$$玉城$$
「But we want to protect what matters to us with our own hands. You've taken a long road, but that's why you're fighting with us too, right?」

DLC2307:3:t_2:26.en:
$$玉城$$
「I'm $$ゼロ$$'s best friend, so a close friend of his is a buddy of mine too. If you've got any problems, come to me.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:28.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As long as $$玉城$$ can keep up his smooth talk, $$新日本$$ is safe.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:29.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Exactly. ...But when he can no longer do that...」

DLC2307:3:t_2:30.en:
$$玉城$$
「H-hey... $$ゼロ$$...! Don't go scaring me all of a sudden!」

DLC2307:3:t_2:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm not talking about $$玉城$$ alone.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$新日本$$'s defense depends on the volunteer army's morale. When they and the citizens despair and give up, this nation is finished.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:33.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$カレン$$ must be feeling that too, now that she's out in the city...」

DLC2307:3:t_2:39.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「It's been a while, $$カレン$$!」

DLC2307:3:t_2:40.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm glad you didn't change your phone numbers. It meant I could see you both again like this.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:41.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「I'm glad... You seem well too, $$カレン$$.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:42.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm managing. ...But are you two sure about staying in $$トウキョウ$$?」

DLC2307:3:t_2:43.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「This city is where I spent my youth. I'm sticking with it, whatever happens.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:44.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「I feel the same as $$リヴァル$$... I'm helping $$ロイド$$ and the others with their research from here.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:45.en:
$$カレン$$
「I see... Then there's nothing for me to say.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:46.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「With things the way they are, anywhere in the world is dangerous.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:47.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「$$沙慈$$ said the same thing. He's working in the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:48.en:
$$カレン$$
「I heard he was studying at $$アナハイム$$...」

DLC2307:3:t_2:49.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「He got a job through $$ミレイ$$ so he could fulfill his dream of working in space.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:50.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「$$ルイス$$ says she'll go there too once her illness settles down.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:51.en:
$$カレン$$
「They're moving forward steadily too, then.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:52.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Since we're finally together, tell us what you've been up to, $$カレン$$.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:53.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「The $$破界事変$$, the $$再世戦争$$... the $$時獄戦役$$...」

DLC2307:3:t_2:54.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Not just about you, $$カレン$$. About $$スザク$$, $$沙慈$$ and the others... And about $$ルルーシュ$$ too.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:55.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah... It's a long story. Shall we sit down somewhere and talk?」

DLC2307:3:t_2:56.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Then let's go to my usual place.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:57.en:
$$カレン$$
「Is it open? The evacuation's already started...」

DLC2307:3:t_2:58.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「The owner was making a huge fuss about joining the volunteer army.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:59.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「He gave me the key and said we could use the place however we wanted while he's away.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:60.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sounds like... a pretty laid-back place.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:61.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「It is. And the coffee he's so proud of isn't all that good, either.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:62.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「But it's amazing. I don't know where he got them, but he's got a huge collection of live $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ recordings.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:63.en:
$$カレン$$
「You like $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ too, $$リヴァル$$?」

DLC2307:3:t_2:64.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「I wasn't that into them before, but I started listening when the Empire began throwing its weight around.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:65.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「When I hear $$熱気バサラ$$ sing, I feel like I can push through any crisis.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:66.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「A lot of people seem to feel that way. These days, it's practically a place for listening to $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:67.en:
$$カレン$$
「His songs... They're giving everyone courage.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:68.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「...By the way, they're popping up all over the world for surprise guerrilla concerts.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:70.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「It's been a while, $$カレン$$. I'm loving that wild look.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:71.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「The President said she had today off, so I invited her too.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:72.en:
$$カレン$$
「I've seen you on TV. You're doing great.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:73.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「Though there are all kinds of restrictions on what we can report.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:74.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「Still, like $$熱気バサラ$$'s songs, I'm doing my best to give everyone a little energy.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:76.en:
$$ニーナ$$
「Your guts magic is still going strong, $$ミレイ$$.」

DLC2307:3:t_2:77.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Just seeing you and $$カレン$$ has cheered me up, President!」

DLC2307:3:t_2:78.en:
$$カレン$$
（Everyone's fighting in their own way...）

DLC2307:3:t_2:79.en:
$$カレン$$
（I'll fight too. To protect everyone who's doing their best...）

DLC2307:3:t_3:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Thank you, Captain $$ガムリン$$. Thanks to you bringing $$バサラ$$ here, the operation succeeded without needless casualties.」

DLC2307:3:t_3:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I didn't force him to come. $$バサラ$$ wanted to go to $$トウキョウ$$ too.」

review.context: Before Tokyo falls, Zero's staff discusses evacuation, citizen volunteers and morale. Kallen reunites with Ashford friends, who find courage in Fire Bomber and Milly's broadcasts. Later Zero thanks Gamlin for bringing Basara.
decisions: Chiba is the Black Knights officer, using the unqualified token rather than the Macross homonym.
The café's raw audio sources are live recordings, not equipment or asset identifiers.
Milly's old student-council title remains President in her friends' address.
Japan and New Japan remain distinct destinations in the evacuation discussion.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
